adapter_limitations: Current stock-bars tool exposes neither page_token nor adjustment. Do not assert complete raw/unadjusted pagination without inspecting its actual payload and validating coverage.
Official bars endpoint sorts by symbol then timestamp and total page limit applies across symbols. A multi-symbol partial response cannot establish the second symbol absent.
Do not recover missing original timestamps by setting availableAt equal to historical retrieval timestamp or assuming 3seconds latency.
No accessible account or fill-history tool was exposed in Alpaca metadata inspected in this task.

external_primary_sources.supports: 5Min aggregates, raw default at HTTP endpoint, total per-page limit, next_page_token pagination; not proof of wrapper implementation
Paper fills are simulation and omit several real trading effects, including latency slippage, order queue position and regulatory fees

feasible_next_step: Use retained captured data for a preregistered fixed-rule historical modeled comparison; original receipts, actual fills and reconciled account economics remain separate missing evidence.
